problems.problem: The draft takes five Flight IIA escorts (sd_ddg_1, sd_ddg_2, vinson_ddg_1, abe_ddg_1, abe_ddg_2) from usn_ddg_burke_f2a_099_late and two (tr_ddg_1, tr_ddg_2) from usn_ddg_arleigh_flt2A_099_2027. These two units carry the same eight named hulls. The 2027 file is '#!alias vessels/usn_ddg_burke_f2a_099_late.ini' (3606774881), and both variants files name Variant1-8 as DDG-99 Farragut, DDG-101 Gridley, ... DDG-107 Gravely. The draft's rule, 'Escort hull variants must be unique across the whole world asset list', can be met by unit+variant and still put one hull in two groups. Example: _late Variant1 as abe_ddg_1 and _2027 Variant1 as tr_ddg_1 are both DDG-99 Farragut. Seven escorts drawn from one 8-hull set leaves almost no slack, and other regions will draw from the same pool.
problems.fix: Make hull number (DDG-nn) the uniqueness key across all units, and record the chosen DDG-nn on each escort asset id now, not 'at build'. Draw the Flight IIA escorts from distinct per-hull-group units (_079/_080/_081/_084/_085/_089/_091/_097/_100/_108_late, _117), which the inventory says together cover DDG-79 to 112. Do not take tr_ddg_1/2 from the _2027 set if the same hulls are already used from _late.

problems.problem: Some chosen units carry ServiceDate windows that do not fit together, and the draft does not flag them, although it flags civ_ms_c7s68 for exactly this (Default ServiceDate ending 2019). (a) Every variant of usn_ddg_arleigh_flt2A_099_2027 is ServiceDate=2027| (tr_ddg_1/2). (b) CVN-68 on usn_cvn_nimitz_2025 Variant1 is 2025|2027. Together they fit only a world dated 2027, and the 2027 hulls are out of date for 2026 (today 2026-10-07). (c) The usmc_ah-1w_late Default squadron in 3737267013 aircraft/usmc_ah-1w_late_squadrons.ini is ServiceDate=2003|2010, yet it is used as 2 x 'AH-1Z stand-in' in asset:usp:sd_lhd_1_ace with no date caveat. (d) usn_ddg_burke_f3_125 (vinson_ddg_2) has hull dates running 2023 to 2037. Only Default/Variant1 (2023|) are valid now; Variant2 is 2027| and Variant3 is 2026|.
problems.fix: Add one scenario-date CHECK to the package listing every date-gated choice. Replace the _2027 escorts with 2022| _late per-hull-group units unless the world is dated 2027 or later. Flag usmc_ah-1w_late as 'Default squadron ServiceDate 2003-2010; date filtering untested', and give an alternative (omit the AH-1 or accept the risk). Fix vinson_ddg_2 to DDG-125 (Variant1, 2023|).

problems.problem: Several connections are labelled basis 'source' when their node target comes from city-level wording or a scenario pairing. (1) North Island -> usp_sandiego_naval_base_san_diego, 'CSG embarkation point for the San Diego carrier record'. R03:17 names no San Diego installation. Holding the carriers on the NB San Diego record is a register or scenario choice (fidelity check 0 fix), and the fidelity pass removed this exact North Island-NB San Diego linkage. (2) NB San Diego <-> usp_kitsap_bremerton_psns, 'Nimitz homeport shifts ... through San Diego' (R03:48, R03:54). R03:48 says the city 'San Diego' and 'Kitsap-Bremerton', so both endpoints are inferred, PSNS included. (3) North Island -> SoCal operating area, 'CQ ... with asset:usp:cvn70_carl_vinson' (R03:17, R03:50). R03:17 is simulation guidance and pairs no carrier. The draft already handles this correctly for its Bahrain and Guam/Yokosuka links ('source for the AOR; the node mapping is authored').
problems.fix: Use the same split for these three links: 'source: R03:17 Pacific-bound CSG embarkation / R03:48 city-level San Diego and Kitsap-Bremerton; node mapping authored (berth unresolved; Bremerton = PSNS inferred)'. For the CQ link: 'source: R03:17 guidance and R03:50 SoCal work-ups; CVN-70 pairing is SCENARIO CHOICE'. Apply the same edit to the mirror rows in the NB San Diego and PSNS connection tables.

problems.problem: The region summary says '99 aircraft held in air groups: three representative carrier wings of 25, one LHD element of 14 and 10 shore helicopters'. That total leaves out the destroyers' embarked helicopters. The draft itself notes 'MH-60R x2 embarked' on sd_ddg_1 and vinson_ddg_2. usn_ddg_burke_f2a_099_late [AirGroup] has usn_mh-60r=Default,2 and the 2027 alias inherits it; usn_ddg_burke_f3_125 also has usn_mh-60r=Default,2. Eight DDGs therefore add 16 MH-60R airframes, uncounted and unallocated in the asset list.
problems.fix: Count them: 99 + 16 = 115 aircraft, or list the destroyer flights as embarked sub-assets (for example asset:usp:sd_ddg_1_flt). Alternatively, state that each DDG keeps its shipped MH-60R x2 and that this is a SCENARIO CHOICE, checking the squadron after every editor round-trip.

problems.problem: Proposed civil air says 'civ_a330 (US, plus Japan, China and Korea liveries for trans-Pacific flights)' on 'the KLAX, KSFO and KSEA world-database links'. The stock links do not support this. In mods-source/_vanilla/original/campaigns/airports.ini, KLAX goes to EGLL, KJFK, KIAH, KMIA, KSFO and KSEA; KSFO to EGLL, KJFK, KIAH and KLAX; KSEA to EGLL, KIAH and KLAX. No Asian airport exists in airports.ini at all.
problems.fix: Label trans-Pacific flights as authored airways, which would cross ±180 (pending P3a), or limit the KLAX/KSFO/KSEA traffic to the stock US/Europe links with US and European liveries. Keep the note that civil aircraft need airways or they orbit.

problems.problem: The gaps cite a backlog that does not hold these items. NB San Diego says 'The Point Loma submarine base and all non-carrier resident forces are not named in the reports (backlog)', and Kitsap says 'NAS Whidbey Island and NS Everett appear only as inventory lookup hints ... (backlog)'. source-register.json nodes.expansion_backlog has no Point Loma, Whidbey or Everett entry; it has only the DLA, Russian base, carrier-wing shore base and NSW items. These names come from the inventory's public-knowledge node hints, which the us-navy method_notes say 'should not be read as report content'.
problems.fix: Write them as 'PROPOSED backlog addition (inventory lookup hint, not in R01-R03)' rather than '(backlog)'. Apply the same edit in usp_kitsap_naval_base_kitsap gaps.

problems.problem: Some support lines state untested negatives as fact, or overstate the finite-supply picture. The summary says 'No supplier pool can be restocked' and NB San Diego says 'No supplier can refill another's pool, and no port restocks one'. The installations-lens verify says to 'Keep none as untested' and adds usaf_c-141b PlaneCargoSupplySystem as a candidate mechanism. The summary also says 'Ship ammunition moves only through finite [SupplySystem] hulls', which contradicts the draft's own notes on RE-power's effectively unlimited suppliers: civ_ms_freighter_a/b, civ_ms_super_p and nv_pt_boats_docks.
problems.fix: Reword to: 'Supplier restocking: not established (untested; usaf_c-141b PlaneCargoSupplySystem is the one candidate, 1965-2006)'. Reword the other line to: 'Finite ship-ammunition supply comes only from SEST-patched hulls; RE-power freighters and docks carry effectively unlimited blocks and are avoided or disclosed.'

problems.problem: The draft cites 'Report totals (57,000 acres, 36,000 personnel, 12,000 acres) are not placement quantities (plan:11)' in the summary and in the Coronado checks. plan:11 says only that no new asset counts, coordinates or readiness schedules are asserted. The rule that a report's size figures are not a placement instruction is plan:65 ('A report's fleet size is not an instruction to place that entire fleet in one harbour').
problems.fix: Cite plan:65, with plan:11 kept as supporting context, wherever report totals are ruled out as placement quantities.

problems.problem: The summary sentence 'The nearest proven sea point is about 430 NM WSW of San Diego (mod 3810611344 "Bell Systems Test" missions, centre 30.0,-125.0) and about 990 NM from Kitsap' reads as if one point serves both. The Bell Systems centre is verified at 431 NM from San Diego (MapCenterLatitude=30, MapCenterLongitude=-125 in '01 Torpedo and Sonobuoys.ini'), but it is about 1,062 NM from Kitsap. The ~990 NM Kitsap figure comes from the installations lens and is a different point.
problems.fix: Split the sentence: 'about 430 NM WSW of San Diego (Bell Systems Test, 30.0,-125.0); Kitsap's nearest proven sea point is about 990 NM away (installations lens; a different point)'.

problems.problem: asset:usp:sd_tao_1 has allocation 'support' ('Local replenishment, small stock') but no initial location or partner. It could be at the pier (resident) or with sd_ddg_1 on patrol, and the plan's initial-allocation field is meant to fix where each hull starts.
problems.fix: State the start: either 'resident_at_base (NB San Diego pier), sorties to rendezvous with sd_ddg_1 on trigger' or 'support, accompanying sd_ddg_1 on the approaches patrol'. Also record the chosen T-AO variant (187/189/193/204) once world-wide.

first_skeptic.verdict:
The region is mostly sound but needs fixes. I opened every R01-R03 line the draft cites (R01:15, 17; R02:15, 17, 30; R03:17, 21, 27, 29, 38, 42, 48, 50, 54, 56-58, 62) and the plan and seed citations. Quotes and paraphrases match, and every fix and missing claim from the three fidelity passes that concerns these nodes has been applied. That covers the city-level home-port recast, the R02:17 rewording, removal of the North Island colocation link, 'such as' for the CVWs, 'strategically vital because it combines', Bremerton = PSNS flagged as an inference, seed:25, the plan:81 extension, 'Pacific' labelled authored, and R03:54, R01:17, R03:29 and R02:15/17 added. The one citation slip is plan:11 used where plan:65 is the right line.

I re-resolved 61 unit ids with find_unit_file. All resolve except usn_mh-60r_26, which the draft does not use. Variant and name facts check out:
- CVN-68/70/71/72 are usn_cvn_nimitz_2025 Variant1/3/4/5; Variant1 is ServiceDate 2025|2027.
- CVN-76 exists only as usn_cvn_nimitz Variant9.
- usn_cvn_nimitz_2000s has NumberOfVariants=2.
- LHD-6 is ServiceDate 2015|2021.
- civ_ms_seabee Variants 1-3 are Cape May, Mohican and Mendocino.
- civ_fv_fishingboat_a Variant3 is 'US' and Variant5 'China'.
- civ_ms_c7s68 Default is 1968|2019.
- usa_airbase Variant1 is 'Naval Air Station' with FlightDeck 2,000,000 (AirTorpedo 72, Ovod 144, Harpoon 144) and capacity 72.
- US_Los_Alamos is OilRig, Role=Target, 1961|1991. FOB is Nation=All.

All supply blocks match the files (T-AKE 550k/110/1.0 nm/13 and 16 kn; T-AO 80k/2000/0.5 nm; Seabee 300k/8000/35/0.5 nm/8 and 12 kn), as do the flight-deck stores (CVN 1.2M, Wasp 45k). Outcome labels follow the verify corrections: AH-1W late, the SEST auxiliaries and the MH-60S stand-in are proxies, and the KA-3B is a dated proxy that is not placed.

Each named carrier appears once. CVN-71 and CVN-72 are underway and not at the pier, with explicit hand-offs; GW is excluded. Scale is small and role-appropriate, San Joaquin stays abstract, and the SOURCE, CHECK and SCENARIO labels are present. Nuclear policy holds: the SSBN is a bare fact with 0 placed and the R03:21 weapons sentence is excluded. No sanctuary rules appear, and Ban Keun does not arise in this region.

Positions and scope figures also check out: x = -8,230 for San Diego and -8,558 for PSNS, 431 NM to the Bell Systems point, the 766/980 NM pool failures, Hood Canal as land, separations of about 5,708 and 8,352 NM, and KLAX at about 96 NM.

Problems to fix:
1. Medium: the Burke escorts drawn from _099_late and _099_2027 can duplicate named hulls, because the 2027 unit is an alias carrying the same DDG-99 to 107.
2. Medium-low: date windows that are not flagged. The 2027 DDG set starts in 2027, CVN-68 Variant1 ends in 2027, the AH-1W late Default squadron is 2003-2010, and later Flight III hulls are dated 2026-2037.
3. Low:
   - several connections are marked basis 'source' although their node mapping is inferred;
   - the aircraft total omits 16 destroyer helicopters;
   - the proposed trans-Pacific civil air has no stock air links;
   - the gaps cite '(backlog)' entries that do not exist;
   - untested restocking negatives are stated as fact;
   - the 990 NM Kitsap distance is attributed to the wrong point;
   - sd_tao_1 has no start location.

Scratch scripts are in /tmp/usp_check/; no repo files were changed.

Both variants files name Variant1-8 as DDG-99 and DDG-101 to 107. second_skeptic.verdict:
The ten original problems are substantively fixed in the corrected markdown, in packages and in named_assets. I checked each against the repo with find_unit_file, winning_file and file_stack, and nothing in the repo was modified.

**Each original problem:**
- **P1 (hull duplication): resolved.** Escort identity is now keyed on the hull number (DDG-nn).
  - usn_ddg_arleigh_flt2A_099_2027 is '#!alias vessels/usn_ddg_burke_f2a_099_late.ini' and names DDG-99 and DDG-101 to 107. The _2027 set is dropped.
  - _099_late V1-V5 are DDG-99 Farragut, DDG-101 Gridley, DDG-102 Sampson, DDG-103 Truxtun and DDG-104 Sterett, ServiceDate 2022|.
  - _108_late V1/V2 are DDG-108 Wayne E. Meyer and DDG-109 Jason Dunham, ServiceDate 2024|.
  - f3_125 V1 is DDG-125 Jack H. Lucas, ServiceDate 2023|.
  - All names come from the winning language_en/vessel_names.ini. No other fixed region uses DDG-108, DDG-109 or DDG-125.
- **P2 (date windows): resolved.** The CHECK at markdown lines 371-381 matches the files:
  - CVN-68 V1 is 2025|2027; CVN-70, 71 and 72 (V3-V5) are 2025|.
  - usmc_ah-1w_late (3737267013): only the Default squadron is dated, 2003|2010; its squadrons carry no date of their own.
  - usn_lhd_wasp V6 is 2015|2021; usn_e-2d Default is 2020|; usn_f-35c squadrons run 2012-2023; usmc_f-35b is 2015|.
  - usn_tao_kaiser is 1986|2055, usn_take_lewis_clark 2006|2060, and US_Los_Alamos 1961|1991.
  - The civilian units have start dates only or none; civ_ms_c7s68 is 1968|2019 and is avoided.
  - The claim 'everything placed fits 2025-2027 except the AH-1W pair and Los Alamos' holds. usn_cvn_nimitz V9, the helicopters and the installations carry no dates.
- **P3 (connection basis): resolved** for the listed rows and their mirrors, against R03:17, R03:48, R03:50 and R03:56-58. One row of the same kind remains (PSNS to Yokosuka, under unresolved).

first_skeptic.verdict:
Mostly sound, with fixes needed: two medium and nine low. Every R0x citation was opened and says substantially what is claimed. The carrier table rows (R03:55/60/61), R03:48/50, R03:19/23/28/30-32 and R02:11/15/17/21/23/25/29-34 all match. The fidelity-register fixes are applied: Newport News is removed from parent_or_colocated, no DLA centre is asserted at Norfolk or Jacksonville, the Richmond and APF groupings are labelled authored, and the Test Pilot School is cited to R03:23 only.

Unit ids: all 54 named in the draft were checked with find_unit_file/winning_file. Every one resolves except usn_mh-60r_26 and usn_mh-60r_2027, which the draft itself flags as unresolved. US_Los_Alamos resolves under land_units, and the draft only rules it out.

Spot checks that pass:
- Carrier variants: nimitz_2025 Variant2 = CVN-69, Variant7 = CVN-74, Variant8 = CVN-75.
- Squadrons: usn_fa_18f_rsa Squadron6 = VFA-106; usn_fa_18e_rsa Squadron18 = VX-4; usn_p_8a Sq1-14 US and Sq15+ foreign.
- Auxiliaries: T-AOE/T-AKE/Algol supply blocks and categories exactly as stated; Algol Variants 1/3/6/7 open-ended.
- DDG: Flight IIA _099_late has 8 hull variants (enough for 4 distinct hulls) and an MH-60R x2 air group with SH-60B at 0.
- Stores: usa_airbase Variant1 'Naval Air Station' with 2M stores; carrier FlightDeck 1.2M stores.
- Date gates: KC-130T squadrons end 2002-2021; C-141B PlaneCargoSupplySystem 60000, 1965-2006.
- Civil traffic: the proposed hulls carry no supply blocks.
- World data: stock KNGU, Port Norfolk ('Norflok'), Mayport, Port Jacksonville and the sea-point coordinates all match; the computed distances check out.

Outcome labels are honest: the T-AKE, T-AOE, port and airfields are proxies, and C-130T, MQ-4C and the test aircraft are missing_fit.

Allocation: no double allocation. Each R03 carrier appears once (CVN-74 only at Newport News), nothing underway is also at base, and the region totals add up (12 hulls, 43 aircraft, 8 hull-borne MH-60R). Scale is small and role-appropriate, the depots are abstract, and Patuxent and Whiting are context or abstract. There is no nuclear detail and no sanctuary rule; Ban Keun is not in this region.

Fixes needed:
- DLA gaps text reintroduces 'implied' co-located centres at Norfolk and Jacksonville.
- The R02:17 'these CONUS hubs' sentence is over-applied to Patuxent, Whiting and Newport News, which R02 never mentions.
- The Truman CHECK should cite the collection's own 'Real World No CVW RCOH' annotation and pre-state the fallback.
- Loading us_ports_atlantic.ini brings in 12 more ports (4 unsourced military) plus civ_ Movements, undisclosed.
- usa_car_hemtt is wrongly called a static target with no function.
- Jacksonville quantities lack a SCENARIO CHOICE label.
- The MQ-25, CMV-22B and MH-60S outcome wording in the Norfolk gaps lags the verify corrections.
- R01 'repeats word for word' overstatements (Norfolk, Jacksonville, Patuxent, DLA).
- civ_fv_fishingboat_a variant labels, the nato_small_airbase Nation caveat, and missing SCENARIO labels on optional markers.

Scratch scripts: (agent scratch, not kept) and detail.py. No repo files were modified.

first_skeptic.verdict:
Mostly sound; fix before use. I opened every cited report line and all match: R01:23, R01:67, R02:21/23/25/27-34/77, R03:38/50/58/59/62 and R03:172 (the line exists). The SOURCE, CHECK and SCENARIO labels are present throughout, and every applicable fidelity fix from checks 1-3 was carried over, except the Andersen missing claims, which were deferred. The only named asset, CVN-73 George Washington, is allocated once and underway. Lincoln and Reagan are referenced, not allocated. Hull and variant choices within the region do not overlap: the two T-AKEs are different variants, and the four Burke units are different hull groups. The three DLA nodes are abstract and quantities are small. Policy is respected: no nuclear detail beyond 'pin a conventional loadout', no invulnerability or instant-disable rule, and no Ban Keun content.

I resolved all 64 unit ids with find_unit_file/winning_file. Variant, squadron and supply facts check out: Nimitz 2025 Variant6 is 'CVN-73 George Washington'; the squadrons used are VFA-27 Sq1, VFA-195 Sq8, VFA-102 Sq4, VAQ-141 Sq16, E-2D Sq9 (named VAW-125, painted vaw-126d) and HSM-77 Sq17; the T-AKE, T-AO, Algol, T-AOT and C8 pools, caps and categories match; Algol Variants 2/4/5/8 end in 2025; the LA Flt3 2026 unit starts at SSN-753; Kilauea ServiceDates end 1980-1998; Tindal carries B-52H x4 and KC-135 x2; airfield_small_1 has 1,000,000 deck stores. Positions also check: the Andersen stock anchor decodes to 13.592,144.935 in plain arcminutes, the Apra land point to 13.296,144.701 (9 NM), Yokosuka's nearest placements are 43 NM away, and the Guam-Pearl, Yokosuka-Pearl and Guam-Yulin distances are right.

One substantive defect: the alternate carrier usn_cvn_nimitz_2027s_adou has an AircraftSupported whitelist that would reject 24 of the 31 proposed aircraft. The rest are low severity: a mis-cited plan:30 (should be plan:24); civ_ms_c7s68 is date-gated to 2019 and civ_a320 has no Japan livery; 'every Pearl link crosses 180' is false for San Joaquin; Andersen's fidelity-2 claims are deferred instead of applied; the Guam R03:38 dispatch claim is not marked island-level and the R03:172 surface-fleet clause is dropped; an MCM idea is attributed to R03:172; NameOverride proxies lack stand-in labels; 'Register role' sits under SOURCE; the region summary's 'only support' wording contradicts the packages' flight-deck turnaround; and the B-52H/KC-135 Squadron1 identities are shared with Tindal and left unresolved.

- Squadrons: B-52H Sq1 2nd BW, B-1B Sq2 7th BW, B-2 Sq1 393rd BS, F-35A Sq3 No. 75, MQ-4C Sq2 Det Tindal, MH-60R Sq20 816 Sqn (Australia).
- Supply blocks for c8, seabee, roro_a, sealift_pacific and ran_aor_supply match the packages.
- AmmoPoints and categories match: DM2A4 4,800; ESSM 700; NSM 8,000 with SEST_LandAttack.
- Refuelling blocks match: no ReceiverSystems on the B-52H, B-2 or F-35A; Boom on the B-1B; the MRTT is ProbeAndDrogue.
- Tindal has AircraftCapacity 200 and no FlightDeck_AmmoCapacity. airfield_small_1 has capacity 48, 1,000,000 AP and an F-4/E-3A/P-3C default group. The fuel and warehouse units are Role=Target and Vietnam-flagged.
- Decoded placements agree: Chagos Gambit gives -7.2945, 72.3865 (about 1.7 NM from the field); SW05, Banda Front and Indo-Pacific Land Assets all give -14.521, 132.378; SW06 is about 5.8 NM off.
- Scope distances recomputed: 4,120, 6,891 and 6,977 NM from 42N 20E; separations 2,837, 3,553 and 1,402 NM; Stirling |z| 4,454.

Every cited line exists and says what is claimed: R01:23, 55 and 68; R02:7, 21, 25, 33 and 78; R03:7, 38, 40, 57 and 172 (172 is the unterminated last line). The checks on R03:40's distances also hold: Diego Garcia to Beijing is about 6,920 km, and the Iran figure fits only the south coast (Chabahar is about 3,845 km).

All fidelity-check fixes for these nodes are applied: the Diego Garcia rewording, the APF link moved to a relationship, MPS dropped as an APF alias, the DLA link as a relationship, 'US' dropped from R03:172, R02:33/R02:7/R02:78 added, and Guam bombers routed to Andersen. first_skeptic.verdict:
The region is mostly faithful and its scale is right, but it needs fixes before merge.

**Sources check out.** I opened every cited line and each says what the package claims: R03:42, R03:44, R03:7, R03:50, R03:57, R02:23, R02:27-34, R01:49, R01:51, R01:69-70, plan:17/22/46 and seed:23. All register fidelity fixes and verify corrections that concern these nodes have been applied. That includes the Muharraq operator, the Jebel Ali assumption, the cluster wording, the HQ caution, the T-AKE/T-AO/903A proxy outcomes, P-8A Squadron1-14, the SH-60B count of 0, unverified KC-135/KC-46, the airbase_us caveats, the FOB display name, Iraq-flag dhows, the C-141B and Puma Squadron2.

**Unit ids.** I re-resolved 62 ids with find_unit_file/winning_file. Only ita_ddg_durand_de_la_penne fails, and it appears in a gaps note, not a proposed force. Spot checks of the files match the package: supply blocks (T-AKE 550k / 1.0 nm / 13-16 kn / 5 categories; T-AO 80k / 2,000 cap; 903A 220k / 5,000 cap), flight decks (DDG 13,800 via #!alias; LCS 6,000; PPA 2,800; nato_small_airbase 60 aircraft / 1.5M; airfield_small_1 V5 Japan 48 aircraft / 1M), squadron nations, Guilin (164) as Variant9, and the Poltava Kuwait V28-40 supply block.

**Allocation and policy.** Nothing is allocated twice. CVN-71 is referenced only. The two P-8A elements are separate airframes. Neutral traffic is allocated once. The headline counts (9 ships, 14+7 aircraft, 13 placements) and the distances from 42N 20E (1,773-2,196 NM) recompute correctly. Scale fits each node: DLA stays abstract, Lemonnier has no ships, the PLA pier is conditional. SOURCE, CHECK and SCENARIO labels are present in every package, and policy is respected: no sanctuary rules, no nuclear detail, not hostile by default.

**Main fixes:**
- The claim that land-unit NameOverride is untested is false: stock and SEST missions use the [Language_en] TaskforceNLandUnitMNameOverride key.
- The ran_pt_boats_docks pier markers show 'RAN base', and the unit's variants are named HMAS Kuttabul / HMAS Stirling. They need VariantReference=Default and a mandatory label.
- The PLA HQ uses nv_headquarters, an unlimited land-unit supplier, which contradicts the region's 'no unlimited shore supply' rule.
- civ_ms_mairangi_bay should be proxy, not exact.
- The LCS at the NSA Bahrain pier must be conditional on the pier check.
- The stock in-Gulf sea links (Port Al Jubayl / Minah Al Ahmadi to As Salamah) are left out of the route skeleton.
- The Gulf of Aden is attributed to R01:51 in the Japanese package.
- Smaller items: a dual outcome label and a leftover edit in the Japanese package, misleading 'return' wording for French/Italian rearm, missing Norfolk/Diego Garcia source connections, and a few labels.

problems.problem: The precedent decodes are handled inconsistently. Scope report §2.1 [GAME, high] establishes lat = centre + z/60 and lon = centre + x/60 with no cos(lat) factor. Under that convention the Souda precedent (Dangerous Straits 1985.ini:98-99,646) decodes to 35.5165N 24.153E, about 0.8 NM from the field. The same verifier discrepancy is treated as resolved at Sigonella and as open at Souda.

first_skeptic.verdict: Mostly sound; fix before Pass C. I checked every cited research line: R03:19, R03:44 and R03:52-62; R02:11, R02:21, R02:23, R02:27-34 and R02:34; R01:21 and R01:59. Each says what the region claims, and nothing is missing (R01:57 is only a heading). Every fidelity fix that touches these nodes is applied: the Sicily attribution, the DLA colocation wording, the Deveselu operator and region, and Souda as pending/mixed. All 62 unit ids resolve through find_unit_file/winning_file. Outcome labels match the verified inventories: the T-AKE stand-in is a proxy, Algol is exact, MQ-4C is missing_fit, Aegis Ashore is none, wp_an_tpy_2 is refuted, and the P-8A uses USN squadrons 1-14 only. The supply figures and categories match the unit files, as do the SM-3, SM-6 and Tomahawk categories, the destroyer variants and dates (ServiceDate 2022-2025, MH-60R Squadron19 = HSM-79 'FDNF Spain'), the stock world-data and mission line citations, and the distances (230-1,258 NM from 42N 20E; Rota-Souda 1,475 NM; Souda-Akrotiri 440 NM). Each hull has one allocation; underway hulls are not also at base, and rotations reuse the same hulls. Quantities are small, and the HQ and depots are abstract. Source claim, check and scenario choice are visibly separate. No nuclear detail appears, and no sanctuary, perfect-detection or guaranteed-intercept rule is built. Remaining defects: (1) the DDG-51 pick reads more into ambiguous past-tense mod text than it says, and the 'returned stateside' quote is put on the wrong hulls; (2) the effectively unlimited Rota pier sits in the baseline, not as a deferred option; (3) a physical sealift hull is parented to an abstract-only DLA depot; (4) the T-AKE and Algol named-hull choices are left to an undefined allocator; (5) precedent decodes are handled inconsistently between Souda and Sigonella. The rest are minor wording or consistency fixes.

first_skeptic.verdict: Sound, with minor fixes. Every R01-R03 line cited across the four packages says broadly what is claimed (R01:31, R02:44/48/55/56, R03:38/59/97/99/101/105/107/123/133/168/172). All three fidelity checks' problems and missing claims for these nodes are applied: R03:97 theatre, Wuxi/Guilin as authored inference, the Longpo alias, the R01:31 tandem link, R03:133 removed as basing evidence, and the Kanoya/Atsugi mirror. All 66 unit ids re-resolved via find_unit_file/winning_file. Hull names, nations, supply blocks (901 400k/9000, 903A 220k/5000, piers 9,999,999,999), FlightDeck pools (Type 003 1.2M, china_large_airbase 3M), air wings and squadrons match the files. plan_f3200a resolves nowhere, as stated. Outcome labels are honest and follow the inventory corrections (901/903A proxy, Song exact, Kilo exact for 877EKM only, 037IIE proxy for Type 022, named Lingshui unit missing_fit, SSBN not placed). No asset is allocated twice within the region, and the carrier and its wing appear once. Scale is small: 22 hulls, 8 land-based aircraft, piers as labelled stand-ins, HQ/JLSF/aviation/radar abstract. SOURCE/CHECK/SCENARIO labels are present on every row. Policies are respected: the strategic force is a bare fact, there is no sanctuary or perfect-detection rule, and fuel, repair and restocking are 'not established'. My own scan of 853 missions confirms the stated distances: Yulin land 9 NM and sea 110 NM, Longpo land 6 NM, Lingshui air 5 NM, Ningbo land 83 NM and sea 203 NM. Extent figures (|x| 5,376-6,102, |z| 726-1,428 from 42N 20E) and MFI:436-440 check out. The fixes are wording and citation precision (the 'US' statement on R03:172, the PLAN 02 line numbers, two co-citations), one check answerable now (plan_3m_80mbe has no AmmoPoints), pinning hull variants so world-level uniqueness can be verified, and minor air-group and collision-list corrections. My scratch scripts are in /tmp/skeptic_chn/ (resolve.py, variants.py, civ.py, scan.py).

problems.problem:
The figure 'plaaf_y-20b (160,000)' is wrong:
- The winning file is mods-source/3782020901/aircraft/plaaf_y-20b.ini, which carries the refuel system only in the Tanker loadout. [WeaponSystem1Tanker] lines 171-173 give SupplySystem_FuelCapacity=75000.
- Before the 6 Oct export (commit 25e18b9b) the value was 45000.
- 160000 is usaf_kc-10's value.
- The IPS verify missed-asset figure is stale, and the package copied it without re-checking.
Separately, 'the airlift has no in-game cargo function' is overstated. The Y-20B has Transport, Tanker and Paradrop loadouts, carrying pla_paratrooper and pla_airdrop_type63. What is missing is an ammunition-cargo supply system (PlaneCargoSupplySystem).
problems.fix: Change the figure to 'plaaf_y-20b 75,000 (Tanker loadout only)'. Reword to 'no ammunition-cargo supply function; paradrop/transport loadouts only'.

problems.problem:
There is a hull identity risk because the packages say only 'a distinct VariantReference for each hull':
- civ_ms_c8 Variants 23-26 are the MSC hulls Cape Fear / Cape Flattery / Cape Florida / Cape Farewell (T-AK-5061/5070-5072).
- civ_ms_roro_a Variants 6-10 are the US Ready Reserve hulls Cape Ducato through Cape Diamond (T-AKR-5051 to 5055).
- The other variants are named real merchants (3432592449 language_en/vessel_names.ini).
US or Diego Garcia packages may allocate these named sealift hulls. The variant's FlagTexture also stays.
On labels: both C8s share the NameOverride 'Mobilised cargo ship (stand-in)' and both Ro-Ros share 'Mobilised Ro-Ro (stand-in)', so the four assets are indistinguishable in game.
problems.fix: Use VariantReference=Default (generic 'Barge Carrier' / 'RORO A') for all four hulls, or reserve explicitly named non-MSC variants in the world hull registry so that no other region reuses them. Give each hull a unique NameOverride that carries its asset id, e.g. 'Mobilised cargo ship E-2 (stand-in)'.

problems.problem: roro-1 and cargo-1 start underway at mission start, and each is escorted by a PLAN escort 'drawn from the Ningbo/Yulin allocation'. That escort is therefore underway from t=0. No reciprocal asset is named, so the Ningbo or Yulin package could also count the same hull at its pier.
problems.fix: Name the reciprocal escort slots in the base packages, e.g. asset:chn-ningbo:relief-escort-1 and asset:chn-yulin:relief-escort-1, with allocation 'escorting' from start. For the reserve releases, state that the escort is taken from units at base at release time and is removed from the base count then.

first_skeptic.verdict:
Mostly faithful and policy-compliant, but fixes are needed before Pass B use.

**Sources and fidelity fixes.**
- I opened every cited line in R01-R03, the plan and the seed: R02:36-59 and R02:77-79; R01:31-37 and R01:67-68; R03:97-99 and R03:105; seed:23; plan:44.
- All say what is claimed, except two points: plan:33 should be plan:17, and the Wuhan package over-attributes to R01:35.
- The fidelity fixes from checks 0 and 2 are applied correctly:
  - Guilin and Wuxi list all three bases under R02:48, and the theatre pairings are labelled authored;
  - the Zhengzhou/Wuhan wording is changed;
  - the network-wide claims R02:48, R02:50 and R02:79 are recorded at Wuhan.

**Unit ids and in-game evidence.**
- All 55 unit ids resolve via find_unit_file/winning_file to the stated winning files.
- The SupplySystem figures for civ_ms_roro_a, civ_ms_c8, seabee, roro_b, mercur, 903A, 901, the RE-power docks, nv_headquarters and tgt_ammo_depot_small match the files exactly, as do variant nations and flags, ServiceDates, lengths and the AOR hull names.
- The AmmoPoints and categories for HHQ-9B (5,250), YJ-18C (5,100), YJ-19 (8,800) and Yu-8 (2,600) match.
- The proxy and none outcome labels are honest.
- Every cited placement line re-derives to the stated lat/lon, and every distance matches within 1-3 NM. The cited placements are the Taiwan Strait:574, Okinawa:402, Paracels:300, Luzon:1100, PLAN 02:507/410, Dong Hoi:294 and the three user missions. Two world-data points also check out: asia_ports [Shanghai] and BackgroundCityFile3.
- The city-name hull collisions and the Laos-flag absence are confirmed.

**Policy.**
- No named PLAN AOR is allocated.
- Each of the four mobilised hulls has one identity and one allocation (transit or reserve), with no respawn.
- Depots and HQs are abstract, and the scale is small (two hulls per theatre).
- Ban Keun is do_not_populate, with empty forces and connections.
- There is no nuclear detail, no instant-degrade rule and no sanctuary rule.
- SOURCE CLAIM, CHECK and SCENARIO CHOICE labels are present throughout.

**What must be fixed:**
- the plaaf_y-20b fuel figure (the winning file says 75,000, not 160,000);
- an incomplete unrationed-round CHECK (HHQ-9C, YJ-17, HQ-16C and the 039B rounds), which weakens the finite-relief rationale;
- receiver-fit table gaps: the Ro-Ro refuses the 056A escort's Yu-11;
- unspecified VariantReference and duplicate NameOverrides, with a risk of reusing MSC-named US sealift variants;
- escort slots that must be carried reciprocally by the Ningbo/Yulin packages;
- minor citation, label and fact corrections: plan:17, R01:35 scope, R02:79 as simulation guidance, the Seabee placements, Yukan's 2020 end date and the Xining superlative.

They are carried on plan_type_052d_p3 (:433/:958, :615/:840), plan_type_055_2026, plan_type_054a_p5 (:816/:901/:986) and plan_ss_type_039b. Seven of the nine original problems are fully fixed and match the repo; P1 and P2 also have text that went stale when the Wuxi escort changed type.

  - find_unit_file shows that plan_hhq-9c, plan_yj-17, plan_yj-18 and plan_yj-18a/yj-20 (3789188689) and plan_hq-16c, plan_yu-6, plan_yu-6a, plan_yu-9 and plan_yu-7c_ship (3775128499) carry neither AmmoPoints nor SupplyCategory.

  - Yu-11 is 2,950 on 056A :297/:379/:500, Yu-15 is 2,950 on 055_2026 :2888, and Yu-10 is 4,850 on 039B :682. None of the three has a category.
- **P3 (Y-20B fuel):** plaaf_y-20b is 75000 in [WeaponSystem1Tanker] :173. It was 45000 before 25e18b9b, and 160000 is usaf_kc-10's figure. The Transport, Tanker and Paradrop loadouts are confirmed.

  - C8 V23-26 and Ro-Ro V6-10 are the MSC/RRF Cape hulls.

- **P6 (citations):** plan:17, plan:33 and plan:36 say what the fix claims. R02:38 and R02:42 support the re-cited points. R01:35 is now limited to the Arm, the HQ and the JLSC count.
- **P7:** the register records R02:79 as simulation_guidance and R02:50 as role. All four hull rows and the summary are now labelled that way.

problems.fix: Add the R03:166 guidance verbatim as a SOURCE claim (simulation_guidance). Add a CHECK that the engine's real datalink and contact sharing between allied MPAs is untested. first_skeptic.verdict: Mostly sound; ten fixes needed before Pass C (placement). Source fidelity holds: every cited R01/R03 line was opened and checked, all fidelity[0-2] items for these four nodes are applied, and repetition is not counted as corroboration. All 33 unit ids re-resolve to the stated winning sources. That includes the squadron and Nation keys (usn_p8 Sq4 UK, Sq5 Norway with callsign Odin; usn_p_8a Sq1-14 US; usn_p-3c Sq21/23/25 Japan; boeing-rc135 Sq2 US) and the absence of 'Default' in AvailableLoadouts. The outcome labels are honest (P-1 proxy, F-35A missing_fit, NASAMS proxy, counter-UAS none), and no named asset is allocated twice. Scale is small, and the Ban Keun, nuclear and sanctuary policies are respected. Problems found: (1) one confirmed id error: Atsugi's car-carrier 'Japan Variant13-24' includes Panama and Norway hulls, among them Variant24 already used at Evenes. (2) Evenes's nato_small_airbase stand-in would spawn 54 unallocated US Cold War aircraft unless its group is overridden. No AirGroup counts are given, so patrol airframes could appear both airborne and at base (all four nodes). The usa_airbase alternative at Atsugi has the same override gap. (3) R03:166's explicit shared-situational-awareness guidance is dropped from SOURCE and then overridden in 'Rules carried' without saying so. (4) The P-1 proxy label cannot yet be shown in game, by the package's own admission, and the conditional Kanoya P-3C shares the stand-ins' squadron. (5) Minor citation and provenance slips: the RC-135 track citation, the fidelity[0] line list, and the FAW4/3rd Squadron inference. (6) civ_as-350 and the visiting mixed-nation aircraft need explicit loadout and representation CHECKs.

second_skeptic.verdict: Mostly resolved: 8 of the 10 original problems are fully fixed, and both declines are sound. I checked every point against the repo and sources myself. The placement is now CustomAirGroup=True with only usn_p8=Squadron5,4, Vingtor is airborne only, and the airbase_us template quirks (the 'S-70B-2_Seahawk=Squadron1=5' line; 3478767194 usmc_vh-3d_squadrons defines only [Default]) are recorded. P2: R03:166 is now quoted word for word as simulation_guidance; the SCENARIO says it departs from it, and a CHECK is added. _integration_consistency.verdict:
The integration is consistent with the final packages on counts, ids, owners and allocations for every asset that has a pin, but about 45 status lines are stale, wrong or ambiguous. It was written from the fixed/ packages, and the final pass then applied every region's second-check items.

**Stale statuses:**
- C14/C24, C23, C30, the C11 San Diego tanker, the C1 'wrongly say' sentence, the 1.5 MSC tanker row and the 1.3 Evenes and Naha ready-up notes are still marked open or 'to apply', but are applied.
- Notes on connection rows 42 and 130, the Engels Tu-160 note in the gaps section and most 5.4 rows also describe work that is now done.

**Real content errors:**
- Section 3's PLAN metering row still lists pla_hq-11 (not carried) and plan_yj-18 (metered). It also calls the 052D/055 heavy rounds unmetered, but the #!extend stack prices them.
- Row 58 cites a Gibraltar connection that no package has, under a source basis R03:44 does not support.
- The Russian bases footprint is 21 aircraft, not 20.
- 1.2 gives the Russian SSBN and CVN-74 allocations in forms the packages don't use.
- Several Burke shorthand ids point at non-late, date-ended files.

**Missing from 5.4:** C6 squadron pins for US Pacific, the W/C Pacific row 42 basis fix, the US Atlantic freighter note it declined, the China support 'not yet in china-maritime' wording, which is now false, and C25 wording still present in Japan/Norway.

- C32: PLAN #!extend pricing, where China support contradicts China maritime.
- C33: Yulin has no surface hull at base for the roro-2 release escort.
